feature: Offers and SOW Acceptance (#3997, Feature #1657) -- the real customer-facing /offers page in artifacts/portal, wired to the 7 real endpoints documented in Design/portal/design_handoff_full_site/docs/offers-and-sow-acceptance-contract-pack.md: GET /api/portal/offers[/:id][/sse], POST /api/portal/offers/:id/[accept|reject], GET /api/portal/presentations/[latest|:id], POST /api/portal/presentations/:id/sign. GET /api/platform/agreement/current is deliberately NOT wired -- contract pack finding §9b establishes it's Shane's MSP-tenant MSA/DPA, not a customer offer-acceptance concept -- so it is not exercised here either.
notes: WHAT THIS COVERS: the auth gates on all 4 state-changing/list routes, the accept/reject id-validation and not-found contracts (§1-§3), that GET /api/portal/presentations/latest always returns a real 'presentation' key (null is a real, honest 'no SOW yet' state -- §10), and a real UI walk confirming the page mounts, the RequireAuth gate still fires for an unauthenticated visitor, and both tabs render for a real logged-in session.

NOT ASSERTED BY EXACT COUNT: this manifest does not assert a specific number of visible offers or a specific presentation id -- the deployed testbed account's real sales_offers/quick_win_presentations rows are live data this manifest doesn't control, and the local dev DATABASE_URL (checked directly for this build: 5 sales_offers rows, all state='draft' for customer_id=1, so 0 customer-visible under the real state filter; 0 quick_win_presentations rows) is a SEPARATE database from whatever backs {{DEPLOY_URL}} -- see the accept/reject 404 tests below for assertions that hold regardless of live data shape.

ENV VARS (BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables): DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD (the same designated testbed portal account other artifacts/portal manifests use, user id 39).
UI login uses the real /login page (#2991), same pattern as account-security-change-password.json -- data-testid='login-email'/'login-password'/'login-submit'.

NOT YET RUN via shaneapp://runTest as of this build: BuildConsole's local instance resolves test-manifests/ against the dedicated dev-server checkout, which only receives this worktree's commits at BuildConsole's own end-of-build merge (Git #1371/#1372 worktree isolation) -- the same structural gap test-manifests/portal/account-security-change-password.json's own notes documented for its own build. Verified instead by a real `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` pass (0 errors) and a real `vite build` (succeeds) against artifacts/portal with this wiring added, plus direct reading of portal-offers.ts / portal-presentations.ts confirming every (status, body) pair this manifest asserts. Re-run this manifest via shaneapp://runTest once merged.

apiTests.name: AUTH-GATE-1 -- GET /api/portal/offers with no Authorization header is rejected (requireCapability('ladder.customer-user')).
AUTH-GATE-2 -- POST /api/portal/offers/1/accept with no Authorization header is rejected.
AUTH-GATE-3 -- POST /api/portal/presentations/1/sign with no Authorization header is rejected (requireAuth).
AUTH-GATE-4 -- GET /api/portal/offers/sse with no ?token= is rejected (401, hand-rolled auth since EventSource can't set headers).
OFFERS-SETUP-LOGIN -- self-contained login so onlyTag=offers-sow-3997 can run standalone.
A1 -- GET /api/portal/offers returns 200 with a real 'offers' array (contract pack §1) -- whatever it holds, it is never omitted or fabricated.
A2 -- GET /api/portal/offers/:id with a non-numeric id is 400 (contract pack §2).

A3 -- POST /api/portal/offers/:id/accept against an id that cannot belong to this account is 404 with the route's own literal message (contract pack §3) -- true for any id this account doesn't own, so it holds regardless of live offer state.
A4 -- POST /api/portal/offers/:id/reject against the same nonexistent id is 404 with the same literal message.
A5 -- GET /api/portal/presentations/latest returns 200 with a real 'presentation' key present -- null is the real, honest 'no SOW yet' state (contract pack §10), not an omitted field.
A6 -- GET /api/portal/presentations/:id against a nonexistent id is 404 (contract pack §5).

uiSteps.name: UI1 -- an unauthenticated visitor to /offers sees the app's own honest sign-in-required panel (RequireAuth gate), not a crash or a silently-empty page.
UI3 -- log in for real through the real /login page (#2991).
UI4 -- submit login, asserting the real response so the landing check below only passes on a genuine authenticated session.
UI5 -- goto the real Offers page as an authenticated CustomerUser.
UI6 -- the page's own real header renders.
UI7 -- both real tabs render (the SOW tab is a real sibling of Offers, not a separate route).
